title: Guide › About this destination: the research in four cards
items: The old Sources section is now Guide › About this destination, in four cards: How we grade, Sources, Liberties, and What lived and grew here. Each card holds the lists that belong to it, from the town in numbers to the animals, plants and open questions.
Guide has a new block that opens each card. Sources and Liberties also point to a building's own Sources tab in Inspect.
The source list now says what kind each source is, such as first-hand or gathered from witnesses, instead of a number.
The order book of what the town still owes now shows only in Researcher mode.
